overview: Based on the published agenda, the Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board of Kronenwetter held a second budget workshop scheduled for October 20, 2026, to continue discussion and deliberation on the 2027 fiscal year budget.
committee: Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board

discussions.body: The committee and board were scheduled to continue budget discussions for the 2027 fiscal year in this second workshop session. This item was set for discussion and possible action regarding the village's proposed budget.

publicComment: Public comment was scheduled on the agenda with a 15-minute total limit and a three-minute per-person time limit, with possible extension at the Chief Presiding Officer's discretion. No action was to be taken on public comments received.
actionItems: Scheduled to discuss and take possible action on the 2027 budget
title: Administrative Policy Committee and Village Board - Budget Workshop 2 - 2026-10-20
